sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Taiwan incense cedar is a conifer endemic to montane forests of central and northern Taiwan, generally at 1,000–3,000 m. This tree can reach about 65 m; its reddish-brown fibrous bark peels in long strips and its branchlets are flattened.

sections.title: Leaves and cones
sections.text: Scale-like leaves are arranged oppositely on flattened branchlets. The woody, ovoid cones are about 7–12 × 6–9 mm and bear 10–14 scales. The plate matches the foliage and cones; its detailed cone is greatly enlarged and not to scale. Conservation status requires a current assessment and is not stated here.
